data.notes: January 2026 in Bangkok was anchored by Bangkok Music City, Thai pop festival formats, arena-scale T-pop, touring indie/R&B concerts, and a strong underground electronic calendar.

events.title: Bangkok Music City 2026
events.summary: Thailand’s international music showcase festival and conference returned to Charoenkrung with 86 artists across eight stages. The official site lists the dates as January 24–25, 2026.

events.title: มาเด้อแลนด์ 2026 (Ma Der Land 2026)
events.summary: A two-day Rangsit-area music festival blending Thai indie bands and molam performance. ThaiTicketMajor lists the event for January 9–10, 2026 at Rangsit Phase Klong 6.

events.title: Cat Radio Presents Cat มือที่สอง
events.venueName: MCC Hall, The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi
events.summary: Cat Radio’s two-day artist market and concert event paired secondhand stalls with a one-stage Thai music lineup. I Have Ticket lists the dates as January 17–18, 2026 at MCC Hall, The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi.

events.title: PEPSI Presents PROXIE The 3rd Concert ‘PROXIMA-B’
events.summary: Thai pop group PROXIE staged its third major concert, ‘PROXIMA-B,’ at Impact Arena. Thailand Exhibition lists the show for Saturday, January 24, 2026.

events.title: Wolf Alice | Bangkok 2026
events.summary: British alternative-rock band Wolf Alice played the Bangkok stop of its Asia run at Ambience Space. Megatix lists the concert for Sunday, January 11, 2026.

events.title: Colde ‘BLUEPRINT+’ Tour | Asia and Oceania 2026 - Bangkok
events.summary: Korean R&B singer-songwriter Colde brought the BLUEPRINT+ Tour to Bangkok with guest artists Khakii and SKOPE. Bandsintown lists the show at Melt Livehouse on January 20, 2026.

events.title: Wisp Live in Bangkok 2026
events.summary: Wisp brought her ‘If Not Winter’ Southeast Asia tour to Bangkok at Mr. FOX Live House. Bandwagon’s tour listing confirms the Bangkok date as January 27, 2026.

events.title: Mustache presents Alle Farben [Berlin]
events.summary: Berlin DJ and producer Alle Farben headlined Mustache Bangkok with support from Jules Blons. Resident Advisor lists the event for Saturday, January 10, 2026.

events.title: FVTURE: Kölsch, Goodboys
events.summary: FVTURE Bangkok hosted a DJMAG-linked night led by Kölsch and Goodboys. Megatix lists the event for January 3, 2026 at FVTURE Bangkok.

events.title: Roger Sanchez at Levels Bangkok
events.summary: House music DJ Roger Sanchez headlined Levels Bangkok. Megatix lists the show for Thursday, January 29, 2026.

events.title: Jungle Jam BKK x BLURRED presents: 30 Years of Fatman D [Drum & Bass]
events.summary: Jungle Jam BKK and BLURRED celebrated MC Fatman D with Nicky Blackmarket b2b Millz, Dogger, Slay, and local residents. Megatix lists the drum & bass night for Saturday, January 17, 2026.

events.title: Jon Dasilva, CHÉ WAX, Malissa & Overmars
events.summary: Original Haçienda resident Jon Dasilva played an acid house set at Siwilai Radical Club with CHÉ WAX, Malissa, and Overmars. Resident Advisor lists the event for Friday, January 23, 2026.
